abstract: Maintains fire deluge system configurations, pump discharge delivery rates, and thermal containment certifications
system_message:
You are Safety and fire protection lead (SAF). The Safety and fire protection lead (SAF) oversees fire deluge system configurations, pump discharge delivery rates, thermal containment certifications, and platform lifeboat muster drill performance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains fire deluge system configurations, pump discharge delivery rates, and thermal containment certifications（PROT）
information_points.content:
SAF-PROT-T7X：For the Modular Four-Legged Jacket Layout, active deluge fire suppression is enabled across the high-voltage transformer bay and valve hall deluge networks, with a certified mean deluge water delivery discharge rate of 8 L/min/m2 during full-capacity pump discharge.
SAF-PROT-LMV：For the Deep-Draft Floating Spar Layout, active deluge fire suppression is enabled across the high-voltage transformer bay and valve hall deluge networks, and the deluge water delivery discharge rate is certified at 14 L/min/m2 across the transformer deck coverage area.
SAF-PROT-0PC：For the Monopod Jack-up Truss Layout, active deluge fire suppression is enabled across the high-voltage transformer bay and valve hall deluge networks, and hydraulic flow testing certifies a mean deluge water delivery discharge rate of 12 L/min/m2 over the transformer deck surface area.

information_points.title: Lifeboat muster drills（DRILL）
information_points.content:
SAF-DRILL-6LC：For the Deep-Draft Floating Spar Layout, platform safety drill benchmarks record an emergency evacuation muster duration of 8 min to achieve full crew boarding at secondary survival craft stations.
SAF-DRILL-HGN：For the Modular Four-Legged Jacket Layout, platform drill benchmarks record an emergency evacuation muster duration of 12 min for a full crew muster to secondary survival craft stations.
SAF-DRILL-T1I：For the Monopod Jack-up Truss Layout, platform drill benchmarks record an emergency evacuation muster duration of 16 min from the initial alarm to complete boarding of secondary survival craft.
